card.name: Linking words in drug interaction sections
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts in drug-interaction text, right before a class of interacting drugs or substances. Examples are 'effects of', 'in combination with', 'Drugs Affecting', and 'Non-' before a drug class.

modes.label: Of/with before interacting agents
modes.description: The words 'of' or 'with' right after 'effects' or 'combination', before alcohol, barbiturates or other drugs.
modes.example: Cyclobenzaprine may enhance the effects<< of>> alcohol, barbiturates, and

modes.label: Affecting and Non- in headings
modes.description: The 'ing' of 'Affecting' or the 'Non' of 'Non-' in interaction headings that name a drug class.
modes.example: 5.8 Risks of Interactions with Drugs Affect<<ing>> Cytochrome P450 Iso

card.plain: It marks the spot in a drug-interaction passage where the name of an interacting drug or drug class is about to appear.
